subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Water Scarcity as Business Risk
description: A short lesson to help you apply Water Scarcity as Business Risk.

hook.text: Cape Town nearly ran out of water in 2018. 'Day Zero' would have shut down every business in the city.

buildup.text: Water scarcity affects agriculture, manufacturing, energy production, and data centers — all water-intensive industries.

discovery.text: By 2030, global water demand will exceed supply by 40%. Two billion people already face water stress.

twist.text: One semiconductor chip requires 10,000 liters of ultra-pure water. The tech industry's water footprint is enormous.

climax.text: Water scarcity is a business risk hiding in plain sight. Companies must assess water dependency before crisis hits.

punchline.text: Day Zero. No water. Every business shuts down. Plan ahead.

quiz.question: By 2030, how much will global water demand exceed supply?
